verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a public REST API giving programmatic control over the entire platform. A probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec at docs.vast.ai/api/openapi.json, and hands-on probes show the public REST offer-search endpoint returning JSON keylessly. An official CLI and Python SDK built on the API, plus scoped API keys for automation, round out a strong, independently corroborated API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform. It's the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.vast.ai/api/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
a bare keyless GET to https://console.vast.ai/api/v0/bundles/ returned live marketplace offers as JSON
For shared tooling, CI/CD, or automation, create a scoped key with only the permissions that workload needs.
